967428e6c1db03ea.message: 'kAiCreditsEnabled' - constant stands in for a runtime signal
967428e6c1db03ea.reason: Deliberate compile-time toggle, not a fake runtime source (D-3, SHARED-CHANGES.md 2026-08-27 removals pass; R-6, docs/redesign/DECISIONS.md). R-6 explicitly asks for the AI-credits line to be parked behind ONE flag so it is reversible in a single edit -- there is no backend 'is this feature on' endpoint to read, and there should not be one for a product decision still pending. This is the intended shape of the flag, not a stand-in for a real source that was never wired up.
